## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 25 captures during August 2021. This report summarises activity at the site for the month, including image quality and grading outcomes. The clinic should continue to record activity consistently so that service performance can be monitored and any operational issues identified promptly.

## Image quality

Of the 25 captures, 1 was assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 4.0 per cent. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk to support investigation and reduce the risk of avoidable image-quality problems.

## Grading

Grading identified 7 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 days. Timely grading should be maintained, with referable results managed through the appropriate follow-up process. The clinic lead should continue to review any recurring delays or equipment concerns and ensure that these are raised through the established service arrangements.
